name: get_drug_side_effects
description: Use this tool to retrieve known side effects of a specified drug by its name. This tool is appropriate when you need detailed information about the adverse effects associated with a particular medication. Do not use this tool for drugs that are not approved or for which side effects are not well-documented. For general drug information, consider using a different tool that provides broader drug profiles.

parameters.name: drug_name
parameters.description: The name of the drug for which to retrieve side effects. Must be a valid drug name as recognized in medical databases.

drug_name.description: The name of the drug for which side effects are provided.

side_effects.description: A list of known side effects associated with the drug.

return_schema.description: A list of known side effects for the specified drug.
